India’s Prime Minister (Narendra Modi)

Main Concepts:
• Leadership style
  • Emphasizes decisive, long‑term planning
  • Focus on national unity and development narratives
• Key policy areas
  • Economic reforms (GST, Make‑in‑India, SVAMITVA)
  • Social welfare (PM‑CARE, National Relief Fund)
  • Technology & innovation (AI adoption, data as a national asset)
• Recent public engagements
  • Extended greetings on National Space Day (23 Aug 2026)
  • Addressed the Economic Times World Leaders Forum 2026
  • Meetings with state governors and international leaders

Technical Details:
• Governance approach
  • Centralised decision‑making with emphasis on inter‑departmental coordination
  • Push for breaking silos between ministries and universities
• Economic initiatives
  • Promotion of Made‑in‑India manufacturing, especially in aviation
  • Support for affordable fertilizers (Urea, DAP) to protect farmers
• Foreign policy actions
  • Strengthening ties with Japan, Australia, Zambia, and other partners
  • Balancing relations with major powers while advocating for global stability

Applications:
• Domestic impact
  • Job creation in aviation maintenance and overhauling sectors
  • Financial inclusion through property‑asset unlocking (SVAMITVA)
• International influence
  • India positioned as a stable partner in Indo‑Pacific security
  • Leadership role in forums like the Economic Times World Leaders Forum

Hope this snapshot gives you a clear picture of the current state and focus of India’s prime minister. Let me know if you’d like more detail on any specific area! 🙂
